item.title: Patch now: BerriAI LiteLLM: Unprotected Alternate Channel
item.description:
BerriAI LiteLLM: RCE · low-privileged account · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 1.83.10

First step: Update BerriAI LiteLLM to 1.83.10 or later.

BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-40217
